periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation angled downward and outward at approximately 45-50 degrees relative to the horizontal facial midline.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Vertically elongated oval with a height-to-width ratio of approximately 1.4:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced inferior tapering creating a teardrop morphology with the lowest point shifted significantly below the geometric centroid.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide horizontal gap across the white cranial fur, approximately 1.5 times the horizontal width of a single ear.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Convex, semi-circular curvature with high smoothness at the superior boundaries.

other_distinctive_markers: Partial exposure of the maxillary dentition (incisors and canines) and gum line due to open-mouth posture; presence of small dark debris or particulate matter on the frontal cranial fur.
